tips.text: Build the Parallax landing craft; its Orokin Eye marks Voidplumes, medallions and treasures for the whole squad.
Run bounties in public squads; plumes pile up because someone is always picking them up.
Do not skip Tier 4 or 5 because the blueprint is labeled Uncommon; its chance matches the component rolls.
Expect unbounded RNG; about 50 completions nearly guarantees a given part, but there is no ceiling.
Steel Path variants pay 150% Voidplumes, but do not assume they improve the part odds.
Treat the 40 Voidplume Quills as a real cost; they also rank The Holdfasts, so spending them delays your rank.
Players complain about variance, not design; several finished the set in a month to six weeks of casual play.
Many players skip the Thrax Plasm bill and farm Gyre Prime through relics instead.
